requirements.description: Second question only, in the negative: there is no f(r) -> infinity such that every 4-chromatic graph whose subgraphs on at most r vertices are 3-colourable contains an odd cycle with at least f(r) chords (APSSV 2026, arXiv:2604.06609 section 4).
requirements.evidence: Statement correspondence argued in STATEMENT.md at the pinned commit, including the induced-subgraph reading and mathlib's IsChord notion; the same file lists explicitly what is not proved (Voss's first question, the sharp constant 10, K4-freeness, full 4-criticality), none of which the recorded question requires.
